messages:
alex: Quick reminder — release cutoff is tomorrow 09:00 PT. If you have deps changes (submodules, vendor dirs, lockfile bumps) please open PRs and tag @maya. We'll freeze main at 09:00. Any blockers?

maya: Thanks. Please include a changelog entry and a short rationale in the PR description. For submodule updates, add the commit hash and reason. For vendor bumps include `make vendor` output or `yarn.lock` diff. I'll do a final sweep at 08:30.

ben: FYI I opened a PR for infra-gateway that bumps a submodule (grpc -> v1.53). PR #412. CI initially passed but vendor diff is pretty large — is that ok to include?

alex: Send the link and ping me. If the vendor diff touches generated protobufs, include a generated-artifacts checklist. If it's huge for churn reasons we may move it to the next release unless it's a critical bugfix.

ben: Link: https://git.redwood/infra-gateway/pull/412. Only updates grpc + protobuf gen. CI showed one flaky timeout test, re-running now.

ci-bot: Build #2158: infra-gateway PR 412 — re-run triggered by @ben. All checks queued.

maya: @ben if tests look flaky please add `flake: true` in the PR description and tag @alex, we'll triage quickly. If you need a cherry-pick to release branch, say so in the PR.

sam: Heads up — web-sdk vendor update brings a transitive lodash bump. Security scan flagged it. I'll attach the SNYK report in the PR.

alex: :eyes: @sam please include the SNYK link and an explicit mitigation (patch, shrinkwrap, or why it's not reachable). If it's only transitive and not called by our codepath we can proceed.

ben: CI passed ✅. Marked `flake: true` and added the gen-artifacts checklist. Moving to merge queue if no objections.

maya: Doing the 08:30 sweep now. If anyone has release-specific DB migrations or feature flags that need coordination call them out now. Otherwise we'll freeze main at 09:00 PT as planned.

ben: No DB migrations from my side.

alex: :shipit: thanks all. Quick reminder command for submodule bumps: `git submodule update --remote path/to/submodule && git commit -m "bump submodule <name> to <hash>"` — include the upstream commit hash in the PR body.

sam: Added SNYK report to the web-sdk PR and noted mitigation steps.

release-bot: Reminder: release freeze in ~60 minutes. See https://go.redwood/releases/notes for the freeze process and merge queue rules.
